name: Alhajri Furniture
note: hajrist.com is a brochure site whose 'online store' link points to alhajri-furniture.com, which now redirects to a GoDaddy for-sale page; the alternate domain alhajrifurniture.com returns 404 on root, /categories and /ar. Real Dammam furniture retailer, but no live transactional channel found after checking all three properties (moved-domain rescue attempted).

name: Karma cosmetics company
note: karmacosmetic.com issues a 301 redirect to a GoDaddy 'for sale' listing; no live store and no operating business found on any other domain. Parked/for-sale confirmed.

name: AL HAZMI STORES
note: Live site is a corporate/store-locator (About, Gallery, Careers, sign-in) for a real ~10-branch Jizan grocery chain, but has no products, prices, cart or checkout, and no consumer app was found. In-category grocery but the digital-channel gate is not met.

name: Modern Perfume Co.
note: Homepage is a brochure (og:description 'Saudi Digital Perfume Marketing Company'); /shop and /store both return 404 and no cart, price or SAR signal appears anywhere on the site. Reads as a perfume producer/marketer, not a transactional consumer retailer.

name: Nahda Modern Company LLC
note: Real 20+ branch Jeddah grocery hypermarket (approved category), but nahda.group/store returns a ~1KB empty shell with no product/cart/SAR content, and the 'Nahda' grocery app on the app stores belongs to a different company (Nahda Egypt & Gulf, UAE). Digital channel genuinely unverifiable either way.

name: Salla E-Commerce Platform
note: Salla is a Saudi e-commerce SaaS platform that merchants use to build their own stores (a Shopify/Zid analog), i.e. B2B infrastructure, not itself a consumer retailer.

name: Modern Furniture & Events
note: Self-describes as furniture, interior and event solutions including commercial/hospitality, custom-made, restaurant/cafe and exhibition furniture, an interior-design/fit-out and events framing consistent with a B2B project/contract model rather than off-the-shelf consumer retail.

name: Skindollize
note: thefaceshop.com.kw is a large live e-commerce beauty store (246 add-to-cart elements, prices in KWD, checkout, 1000+ products) operated by Skindollize, a Kuwait-HQ'd company (Hawalli) with multiple Kuwait branches. A local franchise operator genuinely HQ'd in-country passes Gate 1 (Cenomi/Alshaya pattern); beauty is approved and scale is met.

name: wrraqoon
note: wrraqoon.com is currently Sedo-parked, but it is not a generic empty placeholder as the original reason states: it is a real, substantial Saudi online bookstore ('largest Arabic online bookstore,' ~150,000 titles, prior OpenCart/Odoo build, active social channels). Books are approved; current live-store status could not be confirmed (domain parked, search budget exhausted), so genuinely unresolved.

name: Yahaal
note: Kuwait baby/kids-products business, but it is app-only (web.yahaal.com is an app-download landing page with no catalog/cart) and the Google Play app shows only 10K+ installs, below the 50k Gate 5b floor, matching the Al Sadhan precedent. No Gate 5a web-catalog path exists.

name: Toys Brand Trading Co. LLC
note: Beyond its distributor/'Our Retailers' B2B arm, toysbrand.com.sa/shop is a live WooCommerce consumer store with a multi-page catalog of real branded toys (Nexus dart blaster, Flying Heroes, etc.), prices and cart. That dedicated consumer retail operation (toys, approved) refutes the 'not a direct consumer store' reason and passes on its own merits (Lazurde pattern).

name: Hdaiacom Perfume Company
note: Site title is 'Hdaiakum Perfume Factory' with heavy factory framing and an appointment-booking model; the SSL certificate does not match the hostname and no product catalog, prices or cart were detected on the homepage or /products. Reads as a manufacturer/custom producer, not a functioning consumer retail store.

name: Binzomah Cosmetics
note: Binzomah Cosmetics (Al-Jeel Al-Thany Co., RMZ Holding) is classified as personal-care product manufacturing (est. 2010, Jeddah, ~22 employees); no consumer storefront, domain or dedicated retail arm found. Manufacturing without a retail arm is excluded.

name: Star Markets Trading Company Ltd.
note: Genuine long-established Jeddah/Yanbu supermarket chain (6+6 outlets, Ghazi Abdullah Abbar & Sons), but no e-commerce domain or consumer app is findable and its only online presence is third-party flyer aggregators (clicflyer, d4d). Digital-channel gate cannot be met on available evidence.

name: Trolley Convenience Store KSA
note: Same brand as the Kuwait-HQ'd Trolley (trolley.com.kw) that expanded into Saudi Arabia in 2021; the operating entity is Kuwait-headquartered, so the Saudi arm is neither a distinct Saudi entity (Gate 1) nor a separate account (Gate 6 consolidation).

name: LG Electronics Saudi Arabia
note: LG Electronics is a Korea-HQ'd global manufacturer; the local entity fails Gate 1 (geography) regardless of any Saudi storefront.

name: Zamil Services
note: Zamil Group Trade & Services is a B2B industrial trading/services organization (approved supplier to ARAMCO/SABIC/SWCC across oil & gas, power, chemical, steel, electrical, instrumentation); no consumer-retail component found. Hard-excluded.

name: Value's Home Furniture eg
note: The 'eg' suffix and naming indicate an Egypt-based furniture operation, outside the Saudi/Kuwait/Qatar scope (Gate 1). No in-scope operating entity found; geography-based call (no fresh search available).

name: Foamco Furniture SA
note: Foam/mattress furniture producer (duplicate Apollo record; furniture-manufacturing NAICS 337121/337910). Manufacturing is excluded and a foam/mattress focus also fails the narrow/low-repeat gate (Gate 3).

name: Rawaa Furniture
note: Rawaa (rawaa.sa) self-describes as a furniture design-and-manufacturing company that owns a factory and workshops and provides custom design plus installation/maintenance, a manufacturer/custom-fit-out model rather than off-the-shelf consumer retail.

name: Arabian Furniture & Design
note: Alongside a separate B2B store (afdc-b2b.store), the company runs a live consumer store at arabianfdstore.com with SAR prices (e.g. Herman Miller Aeron 3,943 to 5,491 SAR), add-to-cart, wishlists, a mobile app and consumer payment methods (mada, Apple Pay, Tamara BNPL). Office furniture is within the approved furniture category and the Riyadh entity is Saudi-HQ'd; the dedicated consumer retail arm passes (Lazurde pattern).

name: Gulf Furnishings
note: Gulf Furniture (Doha, since 1976, gulffurniture.qa) runs a live QAR store, but the online catalog is led by flooring (parquet/SPC/laminate), carpets/rugs, wallpaper, curtains and decking under a supply-and-installation project model, which fails the narrow flooring/carpet gate (Gate 3) and the interior-fit-out exclusion (Gate 2); broad furniture appears showroom-secondary, not the transactional focus.

name: Al Haram Plaza  الهرم بلازا
note: Name (الهرم بلازا / 'Plaza') indicates a mall/real-estate/commercial complex, an excluded category; no domain on file and no consumer-retail storefront could be identified. Evidence is limited and name-based; default OUT per the conservative protocol.
